turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
ng 💜 Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return. For a normal return, returns are accepted for unopened products in their original packaging. For a damaged item, you need to submit photos as evidence within 5 days of receiving it, and the case is reviewed individually. If the item arrived broken or incorrect, the claim should be sent with photos to dani@needbeauty.com. You can also review the refund policy here: https://needbeauty.com/policies/refund-policy#main ✨
